added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: the supervisor's baseline no longer narrows to the two trees a fenced run can reach, so every fenced dispatch pays the full-registry snapshot again (312 trees at dispatch in the plan's own measurement, about 3.3 s per tree healthy and 30 s per tree degraded) while section 1's falsifier never drives the supervisor spec path, so no test reddens on the divergence.

_confirm_supervisor_survived is byte-identical to the base revision and still raises whenever an exit record exists inside the two-second window whether or not that record names the worker the supervisor launched (probe in logs/refusal-probe.log), so the fix restores dispatch's return by keeping the supervisor busy rather than by making the return depend on the launch.

the repair is anchored to a condition the diff leaves in place: with a fast filesystem or a small worktree registry the supervisor still completes inside the window and dispatch refuses exactly as reported, so the negative control shows only that the change is load-bearing, not that the refusal has been answered.

the manifest carries no baseline_suite or after_suite field, so the added-failure count for this run is unmeasured for every downstream reader, and its tests line reports the bounded eight-file pair at -n 4 in place of the done_when's -n 8 arm over the dispatch-importing files.

item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that dispatch returns once its supervisor runs again while keeping the two-tree boundary scan, and the landed change restores the return for the observed case but takes the two-tree snapshot off the supervisor path that docs/plans/the-boundary-check-reads-two-trees.html section 1 names explicitly.

justifications.evidence: the named test is genuinely red at base and green at head in my own scratch-tree runs (1 failed EXIT=1 at 57ccb6fe, 1 passed EXIT=0 at 377dba269) and the boundary file is 8 passed EXIT=0, but the done_when's arm measure is unmet and the reviewed manifest carries neither baseline_suite nor after_suite.
